We are finding out the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain region, this area includes the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus.
Human:
```{r}
sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
```
Pig:
```{r}
sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
```
Mouse:
```{r}
sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
```
Humans have the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
